cds.title: Colorado College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Institutional Planning and Effectiveness)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set (G1, G5); Colorado College's Tuition and Fees page shows the same charges (tuition plus activity fee $76,230 = tuition $75,702 + required fees $528; double dorm room $9,616; full meal plan $7,744). Room and board = housing $9,616 + full meal plan $7,744. Estimated expenses: books $1,240; other shown = transportation $1,230 + other $1,800. No total cost of attendance is given. CDS H6 reports 73 nonresident undergraduates with institutional aid, an average of $52,713 and a total of $5,113,171; these three figures do not agree with each other, so no count or average is shown.

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class): 8,822 applied, 1,949 admitted (22.1%), 510 enrolled; the residency rows (Colorado, other US states, international) add up to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 2,370 applied, 164 admitted, 38 enrolled. Waitlist: 400 offered a place, 90 accepted, 20 admitted. Early Decision (both plans together, C21): 764 applications, 272 admitted; Early Action also exists but the CDS gives no count for it. SAT/ACT are optional (the college says since 2019): 28% of first-years (140 students) submitted SAT and 12% (62 students) submitted ACT scores, so the percentile ranges describe those groups only. Average GPA 3.93; 87.06% of first-years reported a GPA, and the bands (all enrolled students) add up to 100%. Colorado College runs the Block Plan (eight 3.5-week blocks; CDS A4 'Other'), so the calendar is shown as 'other'. Undergraduate enrollment (1,887) is the CDS 'Total all undergraduates' (B1; 1,873 degree-seeking); the international count (104) is the nonresident total (B2; 101 degree-seeking).
